cases: prepare a real native continuable child and verify it is released
main composer schedule wakes idle main and the model receives fixed text
cold child receives fixed text in its original session and parent relationship
cancelled child schedule is not delivered
main and child schedules survive actual isolated Desktop shutdown and restart, with both model requests receiving the original text
repeated request identity cannot duplicate native input

evidenceBoundary.changeBetweenFullTestsAndDesktop: Client serial polling and its slow-response DOM regression only; host key-file hashes are unchanged. Final 22 related regressions, typecheck, build, package audit and all six Desktop cases passed.
priorHarnessFailures: dialog close while cancellation RPC was still busy

additionalDefectsFoundAndFixed.problem: Generic cold-root Agent resume bypassed the Web session owner's model and preset setup.
additionalDefectsFoundAndFixed.fix: Use official sessionController.resolveAgent and verify both main and child model receipt after actual Desktop restart.

additionalDefectsFoundAndFixed.problem: Overlapping two-second polling could discard all slower replies and leave the visible plan stale after real delivery.
additionalDefectsFoundAndFixed.fix: Serial polling; actual browser regression with 2200ms replies failed before the fix and passed after it.

limitations: No real provider, five-hour wall-clock wait, long-running stress or real user session history was exercised.
Intermittent Desktop crashes remain unresolved; passing short startup controls and this six-case run do not prove a crash fix.
One-shot children cannot continue. A cold parent that is itself a child must become available through its own native owner.
Legacy previously attempted plans without a stable native identity fail explicitly instead of being blindly resent.
Desktop must be running to execute; overdue plans resume at next startup. This does not wake a powered-off computer.
Delivered means durable host admission, not a successful provider response or quota reset.
